G'oya

Ikki xil yozilgan ismni solishtirish uchun ikkalasidan bir xil kalit yasaymiz. Kalitga uch narsa ta'sir qilmasligi kerak: harflar (LOWER), chetidagi probellar (TRIM) va so'zlar tartibi. Tartibni yo'qotish uchun ikki so'zni ajratib, kichigini oldinga qo'yamiz: Karimov Aziz ham, aziz karimov ham aziz karimov kalitiga aylanadi.

Yechim

Faqat SQLiteWITH p AS (
  SELECT id, full_name, LOWER(TRIM(full_name)) AS n
  FROM pupils
),
pk AS (
  SELECT id, full_name,
         SUBSTR(n, 1, INSTR(n, ' ') - 1) AS w1,
         SUBSTR(n, INSTR(n, ' ') + 1) AS w2
  FROM p
),
r AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(full_name)) AS n
  FROM exam_results
  WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL
),
rk AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(n, 1, INSTR(n, ' ') - 1) AS w1,
         SUBSTR(n, INSTR(n, ' ') + 1) AS w2
  FROM r
),
keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN w1 < w2 THEN w1 || ' ' || w2 ELSE w2 || ' ' || w1 END AS k
  FROM rk
)
SELECT pk.id, pk.full_name
FROM pk
LEFT JOIN keys ON keys.k = CASE WHEN pk.w1 < pk.w2 THEN pk.w1 || ' ' || pk.w2 ELSE pk.w2 || ' ' || pk.w1 END
WHERE keys.k IS NULL

PostgreSQL'da INSTR o'rniga STRPOS, qolgani bir xil:

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH p AS (
  SELECT id, full_name, LOWER(TRIM(full_name)) AS n
  FROM pupils
),
pk AS (
  SELECT id, full_name,
         SUBSTR(n, 1, STRPOS(n, ' ') - 1) AS w1,
         SUBSTR(n, STRPOS(n, ' ') + 1) AS w2
  FROM p
),
r AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(full_name)) AS n
  FROM exam_results
  WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL
),
rk AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(n, 1, STRPOS(n, ' ') - 1) AS w1,
         SUBSTR(n, STRPOS(n, ' ') + 1) AS w2
  FROM r
),
keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN w1 < w2 THEN w1 || ' ' || w2 ELSE w2 || ' ' || w1 END AS k
  FROM rk
)
SELECT pk.id, pk.full_name
FROM pk
LEFT JOIN keys ON keys.k = CASE WHEN pk.w1 < pk.w2 THEN pk.w1 || ' ' || pk.w2 ELSE pk.w2 || ' ' || pk.w1 END
WHERE keys.k IS NULL

So'zlar INSTR / STRPOS topgan birinchi probelgacha va undan keyin bo'linadi. CASE WHEN w1 < w2 ikkalasini bir xil tartibga keltiradi. Natijasi bor kalitlar keys da, LEFT JOIN dan keyin kaliti topilmagan o'quvchilar qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

Ismi yozilmagan varaq ataylab qo'yilgan. NOT IN ning ro'yxatida bitta NULL bo'lsa, x NOT IN (...) hech qachon rost bo'lmaydi va natija butunlay bo'sh qoladi. Yechimda NULL lar r da chiqarib tashlangan, solishtirish esa LEFT JOIN bilan.

LOWER(TRIM(...)) ning o'zi yetmaydi: Nodira Saidova va Saidova Nodira boshqa-boshqa satr bo'lib qoladi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da so'zni ajratishning qisqa yo'li bor: SPLIT_PART(n, ' ', 1) va SPLIT_PART(n, ' ', 2). SQLite'da bunday funksiya yo'q, shuning uchun INSTR va SUBSTR bilan.
